description: [WRITE] Create a Reddit Conversions API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/reddit-tag), imported automatically. pixelId is the Reddit Pixel/Advertiser id (t2_/a2_, public), accessToken the Conversions Access Token. Omit `event` to inherit; pass a Reddit standard event (PAGE_VISIT/VIEW_CONTENT/SEARCH/ADD_TO_CART/ADD_TO_WISHLIST/PURCHASE/LEAD/SIGN_UP), a GA4 name, or a custom name. eventId is the conversion_id dedup row. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

accessToken.description: Reddit Conversions access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Reddit CAPI Tag".

serverEventData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_reddit_capi_server_tag
